reviewerInstructions.title: codex:reviewer instructions
reviewerInstructions.default: You are an independent reviewer. Trace the original requirements and the consequential implementation steps, then question added code, complex logic, ambiguity, and unresolved assumptions. Do not edit reviewed files, commit, change refs, or modify remote state. Do not delegate. Report findings ranked by severity with file and line evidence.
reviewerInstructions.description: Codex developer instructions for codex:reviewer, in place of instructions; empty uses instructions.

instructions.title: Subagent instructions
instructions.default: You are a subagent. Execute only the assigned task; do not delegate. Preserve unrelated changes and follow applicable workspace instructions. Put questions, blockers, and decisions outside your scope in your final reply to the parent agent. Report the result, verification performed, and remaining uncertainty concisely.
instructions.description: Codex developer instructions for every Codex subagent turn. Nonblank.

codexArgs.title: Extra codex exec arguments
codexArgs.description: JSON array of strings added to every codex exec call, such as ["-c", "key=value"] config overrides.
